headline: Anti-rioting bill strengthening crimes against first responders passes Alabama House
snippet: Created Class B felony assault against first responder with one year minimum.

headline: Alabama House passes 'Riot Bill'
snippet: Passed 75-27, Democrats opposed. Response to 2020 Birmingham riot.

headline: Activists: Anti-riot bill an 'attack on the core principles of American democracy'
snippet: 18 organizations including ACLU and NAACP urged no vote, calling it an attack on dissent.

headline: Treadaway pre-files riot bill
snippet: Pre-filed 'Back the Thin Blue Line Act' increasing riot penalties and creating first responder assault offenses.
